Requirement statement: Keep the sales forecast category aligned with the deal’s stage so pipeline reporting stays consistent.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Separate unqualified intake from qualified sales pipeline and keep this important sales forecast field consistent throughout the process.
Acceptance criteria: Stage 0 is Pre-pipeline; 1–2 Pipeline; 3–4 Upside; 5–6 Commit; 7–8 Won; losses show Loss. Valid direct Stage 1 creation starts in Pipeline.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse Forecast Category (Sales). Standard Salesforce forecast fields remain separate.

Requirement statement: Give every inbound deal an accountable seller and a recorded acceptance decision before it enters qualified pipeline.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Prevent unowned handoffs.
Acceptance criteria: Inbound deals advance only after assignment, acceptance and qualification. Assigned sellers can still create self-qualified deals directly in Stage 1.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Keep SAL creation separate from seller acceptance. Opportunities remain owned by a user.

Requirement statement: Apply CHAMPS consistently so every deal meets the qualification standard for its intake path.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Retain initial discovery separately from MEDDPICC pain.
Acceptance criteria: Inbound deals complete all five CHAMPS answers before Stage 1; seller-self-qualified deals complete them before Stage 2. Reassignment does not change the rule.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse the existing CHAMPS fields and preserve the original intake path.

Requirement statement: Require complete discovery, accountable AE/SE owners and buying contacts before solution design.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Establish business fit and discovery evidence before solution design; early Budgetary quoting does not bypass qualification.
Acceptance criteria: Stage 2 requires the discovery inputs, CHAMPS, Route to Market, AE/Primary SE and at least one Contact Role.
Rev Ops refinement notes: The originating Contact is identified at creation; buying roles develop during discovery.

Requirement statement: Support early budget estimates while keeping firm proposals and later quote changes controlled.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Permit controlled early budgetary estimates while preserving discovery, technical/commercial gates and booked-record locks.
Acceptance criteria: Allow controlled Budgetary quoting in Stages 0–1 and regular quoting in 2–5. Stage 6 corrections return to 5; booked deals stay protected.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse existing CPQ and Primary Quote synchronization. See Quoting for release requirements.

Requirement statement: Require documented customer pain, technical fit and evaluation evidence before buyer alignment.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Capture technical fit across candidate configurations.
Acceptance criteria: Stage 3 requires the Stage 2 technical inputs and a POC decision. A required POC must be Completed or Cancelled.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Keep the existing Description and POC controls; update only the missing requirements.

Requirement statement: Make POC progress visible and prevent unresolved evaluations from moving forward.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Avoid alignment before technical validation is complete.
Acceptance criteria: If POC Required? is Yes, progression beyond Stage 2 requires Completed or Cancelled. If No, a POC is unnecessary. Stage skips follow the same rule.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Add POC Status and POC Updates; retain existing POC Required? and POC Engagement.

Requirement statement: Confirm customer preference for DDN and one agreed configuration before proposal and negotiation.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Confirm a technical win and buying alignment.
Acceptance criteria: Stage 4 requires Technical Win, the selected configuration, Operational Value, Economic Buyer and Decision Process. In Progress cannot pass.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Technical Win requires customer-confirmed preference; technical fit or a completed POC alone is insufficient.

Requirement statement: Build a complete business and purchasing case before procurement.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align commercial value, stakeholders and procurement planning.
Acceptance criteria: Stage 5 requires Business Value, a Primary Quote, Paper Process and Requested Install Date.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Move Paper Process into Stage 4; reuse the existing quote process.

Requirement statement: Complete procurement and delivery requirements before handing a won decision to Order Management.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Provide a complete order package.
Acceptance criteria: Stage 6 requires shipping/delivery requests, IPG disposition, secured PO and its file, final agreements and delivery instructions.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse existing IPG and file controls. A PO reference alone is insufficient.

Requirement statement: Give OM a reconciled order and an agreed GSS logistics plan before booking.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Keep Salesforce aligned with the actual order.
Acceptance criteria: Only authorized OM can move 6 → 7 after reconciliation. Booked facts stay protected while authorized delivery and invoice-reference updates remain possible.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Start deployment planning at Stage 6. Protect booked values without blocking post-booking work.

Requirement statement: Complete the sales opportunity when all applicable booked items are received on site.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Separate delivery evidence from shipment and billing events.
Acceptance criteria: OM moves 7 → 8 on verified complete receipt; partial delivery stays at 7. Pending financial invoicing does not block completion.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Keep the Invoice stage label. Continue invoice reconciliation on the Order and deployment on the Case.

Requirement statement: Start deployment planning at the won decision with one coordinating PS Case.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Keep execution detail in the existing service workspace.
Acceptance criteria: Stage 6 creates or links the Case. Re-entry reuses it, and failed transitions leave no duplicate or orphan Case. OM/GSS planning is ready before booking.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse existing Case relationships; confirm the applicable process for deals without physical delivery.

Requirement statement: Track whether customers achieve the promised value after purchase.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Measure customer value separately from case resolution.
Acceptance criteria: The PS Case captures the plan, target date, outcome, evidence and Time to Value. Post-sale assessment does not hold open or reopen the Opportunity.
Rev Ops refinement notes: GSS owns the assessment. Reuse sales-defined Operational Value and Business Value.

Requirement statement: Keep AE and SE next actions current and make stale deals visible.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Keep execution and management guidance current.
Acceptance criteria: Open Stage 1–6 deals show separate weekly AE/SE reviews and are flagged after seven days without review. Booked Close Date remains protected.
Rev Ops refinement notes: A review can confirm an unchanged action. Unrelated record edits do not refresh it.

Requirement statement: Give Sales Engineering and Product a clear way to manage deal-related feature requests.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Track technical impediments alongside the deal.
Acceptance criteria: Feature requests created in Stages 2–5 have a linked Case, title and description. Existing technical-risk tracking continues.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse Cases and the existing risk process; a request is not a roadmap commitment.

Requirement statement: Show every account’s role in a deal, including partners, end customers and other contributors.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Track partner participation and NCP end users without a single-partner limit.
Acceptance criteria: Associated accounts records capture the account, primary role, classification, engagement plan, contacts and status while preserving existing relationships.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Extend Partner Opportunity Influence and reuse its existing fields where specified.

Requirement statement: Base partner credit on documented origin and the first qualifying partner involvement.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Provide stage-based attribution evidence.
Acceptance criteria: Qualifying associations and approved registrations produce the defined contribution category. Credit freezes at booking; later changes do not rewrite it.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Move the trigger from Primary Partner to Associated accounts. Retain audited management overrides.

Requirement statement: Keep NVIDIA engagement information tied to its actual involvement in the deal.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Retain partner-specific context.
Acceptance criteria: An active NVIDIA association triggers the relevant engagement requirements. NVIDIA account plans and next steps sit on that association.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse the existing Opportunity engagement fields; avoid duplicate capture.

Requirement statement: Capture useful win evidence and deliver the right win notifications.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Capture the win narrative and confirmed booked facts.
Acceptance criteria: Stage 6 applies the agreed win, recognition and interview requirements. Notifications follow the Win/Loss guide without duplicates.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Check the existing Win/Loss rollout before adding fields or automation.

Requirement statement: Capture why a deal was lost and the next action without forcing irrelevant competitor answers.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Capture learning and follow-up after a loss.
Acceptance criteria: Loss reason, explanation and next action are required. The three approved reasons allow blank competition; selecting Other still requires detail. Interview rules apply separately.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Competitor exemptions: Opportunity Misqualified, Project Cancelled / Budget Lost, No Decision / Went Dark. Misqualification applies only from Stage 0.

Requirement statement: Remove unnecessary legacy prompts and consolidate win justification into Business Value.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Simplify the workflow without deleting history.
Acceptance criteria: Removed prompts no longer block progression. Optional context and historical values remain available.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Follow the field tables for the exact moves and removals.

Requirement statement: Rename Primary Partner to Transacting Partner once it no longer drives source attribution.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Separate the commercial transacting partner from partner credit and physical delivery.
Acceptance criteria: The new label is applied after Associated accounts and the replacement attribution rules are working; existing relationships and history remain intact.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Complete the attribution dependency before the rename.

Requirement statement: Preserve a readable history of POC progress.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Keep short updates useful without losing progress history.
Acceptance criteria: Each POC update retains its full prior text, author and time.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Confirm history can retain the complete text; use a dated log if needed.

Requirement statement: Use consistent win/loss reasons and vendor information to improve analysis.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Separate outcome reasons from vendor identity.
Acceptance criteria: Won Reason, Loss Reason, competitors and incumbent capture follow the approved guide, with historical values preserved.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Confirm the shared competitor taxonomy and reuse fields already delivered by the Win/Loss rollout.

Requirement statement: Capture whether customers can be approached for feedback, asking only for relevant details.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Provide actionable, clean interview handoffs.
Acceptance criteria: For New/Existing/Renewal, eligibility is required at win/loss except Stage 0 misqualification. Yes requires a Contact; No requires a reason; an exempt blank answer requires neither.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse the Win/Loss fields. Budget-lost and went-dark losses still require eligibility.

Requirement statement: Send win/loss information to the right people at the agreed time.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Deliver consistent learning while controlling distribution.
Acceptance criteria: Notifications meet the guide’s thresholds, recipients and deadlines, occur once per event, and keep restricted loss reports out of the win channel.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Check what the existing rollout already delivers before adding automation.

Requirement statement: Capture verified deal origin at creation so source credit is reliable.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Attribute pipeline to its actual source and remove avoidable manual entry.
User role / process: Sales / BDR / Marketing / Partners / Salesforce Admin
Acceptance criteria: Direct/BDR requires Sourcing User; Marketing requires Sourcing Campaign; Partner requires Sourcing Partner. A blank source or missing applicable reference blocks creation.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Use the originating person, campaign or partner, rather than the current owner or integration user.

Requirement statement: Bring Marketing and AI qualification into a consistent Contact lifecycle.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Measure human/marketing and agentic qualification as distinct entry cohorts.
Acceptance criteria: MAP records MQL and PAX.AI records AQL against the correct Contact. Repeated or late events do not duplicate credit or downgrade lifecycle status.
Rev Ops refinement notes: MQL and AQL are separate qualification paths. Confirm source-system mappings.

Requirement statement: Track SAL and SQL against the originating Contact so conversion reporting reflects genuine qualification.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Report conversion and timing across Contact, Account and Opportunity without duplicating lifecycle systems.
Acceptance criteria: Creation records SAL. First qualified entry to Stages 1–8 records SQL, including valid skips. A valid 0 → 4 records SQL and Pipeline Date while Stage 1 Date stays blank.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Preserve each deal’s conversion history and existing customer status. Re-entry must not duplicate SQL.

Requirement statement: Put SAL review in Validate so sellers can clearly accept or reject inbound handoffs.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Expose marketing and partner handoffs and explain rejected or stalled SALs.
Acceptance criteria: Acceptance/rejection records the decision and required dates or notes. Pending or rejected inbound deals cannot enter qualified pipeline.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse existing SAL controls and confirm what their current date fields mean.

Requirement statement: Identify whether a quote is an estimate or a final commercial proposal.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Distinguish budgetary estimates from best-and-final quotes.
Acceptance criteria: Every CPQ Quote has Quote Purpose set to Budgetary or Best and Final, with the appropriate release requirements enforced.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Add this field to the Quote, not the Opportunity.

Requirement statement: Make urgent quote requests visible and explain why they need priority.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Communicate exceptional timing needs with an explanation.
Acceptance criteria: Timing Urgency defaults to Standard. Selecting Urgent requires an Urgency Reason.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Keep both fields on the CPQ Quote.

Requirement statement: Let teams record available competitor pricing to support commercial decisions.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Capture known competitor pricing context during quoting.
Acceptance criteria: Competitor Pricing is optional on the CPQ Quote and explains what pricing visibility to capture.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Use the agreed help text; do not make competitor pricing a quoting prerequisite.

Requirement statement: Record how the deal will transact, separately from who originated it.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Capture the commercial route without mixing it with lead source.
Acceptance criteria: Route to Market is Direct or Indirect. Indirect requires Resell/distribution, GSI, OEM, NCP or CSP; Direct requires no subtype.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Capture during discovery, or earlier for a Budgetary quote. CSP includes hyperscalers.

Requirement statement: Allow deals to include more than one Product Type.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Represent opportunities involving multiple product families.
Acceptance criteria: Users can select multiple existing Product Type values and historical selections remain available.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Keep the current choice list.

Requirement statement: Make the primary GSS contact easy to find when assigned.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Identify the dedicated GSS member when an opportunity has one.
Acceptance criteria: An optional Primary GSS user lookup appears in the Opportunity summary without blocking progression.
Rev Ops refinement notes: This identifies the contact; it does not replace deployment Case ownership.

Requirement statement: Calculate partner contribution consistently from origin and the timing of partner involvement.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Apply Partner-only, Partner-Led, Joint or the existing no-partner category using the agreed rules. Freeze automated credit at booking; retain audited overrides.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Part of BR-SS-022. Preserve original involvement evidence through ownership and stage changes.

Requirement statement: Rename Why DDN to Identify Pain to capture validated customer problems in Stage 2.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Identify Pain is available at Stage 2 with existing Why DDN history retained.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Keep CHAMPS Challenge as a separate qualification answer.

Requirement statement: Rename SE User to Primary SE so technical accountability is clear.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Primary SE identifies the assigned sales engineer alongside the AE, with existing assignments retained.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse the existing user field.

Functional Area: Field definition / Stage 2, Stage 3, Ongoing activities
Requirement statement: Rename Solution to Technical Value and capture the technical case for DDN.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Stage 2 records technical fit and configurations; Stage 3 identifies one selected configuration. Existing content remains available.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse the existing Solution field.

Requirement statement: Capture the operational improvement the customer expects from DDN.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Operational Value records outcomes, baseline, target and measurement expectations in Stage 3.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Confirm a suitable reuse candidate or add the field; Why DDN remains Identify Pain.

Functional Area: Field definition / Stage 4, Stage 6, Ongoing activities
Requirement statement: Rename Economic Justification to Business Value and connect the business case to the win.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Stage 4 captures quantified business value; Stage 6 adds win detail and ROI or cost-saving evidence. Existing history is retained.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Use the same field throughout the deal.

Requirement statement: Move purchasing milestones into Stage 4 as Paper Process.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Paper Process covers legal, procurement, signatures and PO steps before Stage 5.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Rename and reuse Procurement (Close Plan).

Requirement statement: Make technical-document links easy to identify in Stage 2.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: SharePoint Link replaces the Sharepoint Links label while retaining the existing rich text and links.
Rev Ops refinement notes: This is a label and placement change.

Requirement statement: Make IPG completion explicit before the won-decision handoff.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: IPG Finalized requires Completed or Not Required before Stage 6.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Rename the existing IPG Finalized and submitted field; keep its choices.

Requirement statement: Clarify the label for the sales engineer’s next actions.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Sales Engineer Next Steps replaces SE Next Steps with existing content retained.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Weekly review evidence is covered by BR-SS-019.

Requirement statement: Identify the economic decision-maker during buyer alignment.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Economic Buyer appears in Stage 3 with the existing Budget holder content retained.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Rename and move the existing text field; no new lookup is needed.

Requirement statement: Capture the actual winning competitor only when relevant to the loss.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: The three approved noncompetitive reasons allow a blank Competitor Lost To. Other reasons require it; selecting Other always requires detail.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Align with the approved competitor list. Retain Not lost to competitor and leave membership validation off at launch.

Requirement statement: Capture the requested installation date early enough to plan delivery.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Requested Install Date is captured in Stage 4 and remains distinct from actual installation completion.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Confirm applicability for non-shipping deals with OM/GSS; do not invent dates.

Requirement statement: Capture Sales’ shipping estimate before the order is finalized.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Estimated Shipping Date is maintained in Stage 5 and remains separate from later Order shipping commitments.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Keep the original estimate. Confirm applicability for non-shipping deals with OM/GSS.

Requirement statement: Carry the customer’s delivery request from the deal into the order handoff.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Requested Delivery Date is captured in Stage 5 and reconciled with the existing Order date.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse the Order field. Confirm applicability for non-shipping deals with OM/GSS.

Requirement statement: Rename PO Processing Status to Order Review Status to clarify booking readiness.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: OM confirms order reconciliation before 6 → 7 using approved processing and exception states; a populated status alone does not permit booking.
Rev Ops refinement notes: RevOps and OM must agree how existing statuses map to booking decisions.

Functional Area: Field definition / PS Case value realization
Requirement statement: Start value tracking from verified customer receipt.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Enable GSS to track customer value independently of the completed sales opportunity.
Acceptance criteria: Value Tracking Start Date on the PS Case captures the first Stage 8 delivery milestone and remains unchanged on retries or reassignment.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Part of BR-SS-018. Use the delivery milestone, not the financial invoice date.

Functional Area: Field definition / PS Case value realization
Requirement statement: Give GSS a plan for confirming the value promised during the sale.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Enable GSS to track customer value independently of the completed sales opportunity.
Acceptance criteria: The PS Case records the value-validation plan from Stage 6 and supports assessment after delivery.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Part of BR-SS-018. Reference Operational Value and Business Value.

Functional Area: Field definition / PS Case value realization
Requirement statement: Set a clear target for confirming customer value.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Enable GSS to track customer value independently of the completed sales opportunity.
Acceptance criteria: Target Value Realization Date is recorded on the PS Case; changes retain an explanation.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Part of BR-SS-018. This does not delay Opportunity completion.

Functional Area: Field definition / PS Case value realization
Requirement statement: Distinguish pending, achieved and unmet customer value.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Enable GSS to track customer value independently of the completed sales opportunity.
Acceptance criteria: Value Achieved? stays blank while pending; a completed assessment records Yes or No on the PS Case.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Part of BR-SS-018. Final assessment is separate from Opportunity completion.

Functional Area: Field definition / PS Case value realization
Requirement statement: Explain the evidence behind the customer’s value outcome.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Enable GSS to track customer value independently of the completed sales opportunity.
Acceptance criteria: Value Realization Context records measured results and confirmation, or the gap and agreed action when value is not achieved.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Part of BR-SS-018. Keep the evidence on the PS Case.

Functional Area: Field definition / PS Case value realization
Requirement statement: Record when the value assessment was completed.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Enable GSS to track customer value independently of the completed sales opportunity.
Acceptance criteria: Value Outcome Confirmed Date records the final Yes/No assessment on the PS Case.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Part of BR-SS-018. This is separate from deployment completion and Case closure.

Functional Area: Field definition / PS Case value realization
Requirement statement: Measure how long customers take to achieve value after receipt.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Enable GSS to track customer value independently of the completed sales opportunity.
Acceptance criteria: Time to Value calculates days from the delivery milestone to confirmed achievement. Pending or No outcomes stay blank; the outcome cannot precede the start.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Part of BR-SS-018. Calculate on the PS Case without reopening the Opportunity.

Requirement statement: Clarify the reference for the current deal’s sales order.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Sales Order Reference replaces Order No. and retains the existing order reference.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Keep Original SO# separate for original-order references.

Requirement statement: Make the invoice reference clear without delaying delivery-led completion.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Invoice Reference replaces Invoice # and is required when issued. Pending invoicing does not block Stage 8.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Part of BR-SS-015. Continue invoice reconciliation on the Order.

Requirement statement: Make the coordinating deployment Case visible from the deal.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Deployment Case Link reuses the existing PS Case relationship from Stage 6; re-entry does not create a duplicate Case.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Part of BR-SS-017. Confirm existing relationships and non-shipping applicability.

Requirement statement: Capture whether the commercial route is Direct or Indirect.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Route to Market is recorded during discovery, or before an early quote; Indirect requires a route type.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Part of BR-SS-037. Keep route separate from source and partner credit.

Requirement statement: Describe the indirect route without adding unnecessary questions to Direct deals.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Indirect Route Type is required only for Indirect: Resell/distribution, GSI, OEM, NCP or CSP. Previous selections remain in history when the route changes.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Part of BR-SS-037. CSP includes hyperscalers.

Requirement statement: Capture a consistent reason for the customer’s decision to buy.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Won Reason is required on entry to Stage 6 and uses the agreed choices, with historical values preserved.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Use the Win/Loss guide taxonomy.

Requirement statement: Identify the partner handling the commercial transaction.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Transacting Partner replaces Primary Partner after attribution changes are ready. Existing links remain, and OM verifies the actual shipping destination separately.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Keep transacting partner, originating partner and ship-to distinct.

Requirement statement: Show POC progress and prevent unresolved required evaluations from advancing.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: POC Status defaults to None. When a POC is required, only Completed or Cancelled permits progression beyond Stage 2, including skips.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Part of BR-SS-008. Keep the agreed POC status choices.

Requirement statement: Capture short, traceable POC progress updates.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: POC Updates accepts up to 255 characters and retains full prior updates with author and time.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Part of BR-SS-008; history is covered by BR-SS-032.

Functional Area: Field definition / Ongoing activities, Partner relationships
Requirement statement: Allow any participating account to be linked to the deal.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Associated Account replaces Partner and supports partners, end customers and other accounts without losing existing links.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse the existing Account lookup.

Functional Area: Field definition / Ongoing activities, Partner relationships
Requirement statement: Make each account’s primary role in the deal clear.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Each association has one primary Role On Deal and one classification. Secondary contributions go in the plan without duplicating the association.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Extend the existing role choices; preserve Transacting and Influencer history.

Functional Area: Field definition / Ongoing activities, Partner relationships
Requirement statement: Describe the type of account participating in the opportunity.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Each Associated Account has the agreed Account Classification, separate from its role in the deal.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Use the specified choices; CSP includes hyperscalers.

Functional Area: Field definition / Ongoing activities, Partner relationships
Requirement statement: Capture how the associated account will contribute to the deal.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Association Description / Plan replaces Description (Influence), retaining existing narrative and engagement plans.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Explain Other role or classification selections here.

Functional Area: Field definition / Ongoing activities, Partner relationships
Requirement statement: Make each associated account’s engagement status clear.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Association Engagement Status replaces Partner Stage (Influence), keeping the required Active/Inactive choices and history.
Rev Ops refinement notes: This changes the label, not the choice list.

Functional Area: Field definition / Ongoing activities, Partner relationships
Requirement statement: Identify the sales contact for each participating account.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Association Sales Contact replaces Primary Contact (Partner), retaining existing Contact links.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Maintain the technical contact separately.

Functional Area: Field definition / Ongoing activities, Partner relationships
Requirement statement: Identify the technical contact for each participating account.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Association Technical Contact replaces Technical Contact (Partner), retaining existing Contact links.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse the existing Contact lookup.

Requirement statement: Recognize the people who contributed to major wins.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Wins of at least $1M require Resources Engaged on entry to Stage 6.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse the Win/Loss rollout field if already available.

Requirement statement: Record the customer’s incumbent vendors to understand displacement.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Incumbent Vendor(s) is captured at Stage 6 using the aligned vendor list, or Not Applicable when there is no incumbent.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Confirm the shared taxonomy and reuse any existing rollout field.

Functional Area: Field definition / Stage 6, Closed lost, Ongoing activities
Requirement statement: Record whether the customer may be approached for win/loss feedback.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: New/Existing/Renewal wins and losses require eligibility, except Stage 0 misqualification. A blank answer is permitted only under that exemption.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse the rollout field. Budget-lost and went-dark losses still require eligibility.

Functional Area: Field definition / Stage 6, Closed lost, Ongoing activities
Requirement statement: Give the Win/Loss team a usable customer contact when outreach is allowed.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: OK to Interview = Yes requires a linked Salesforce Contact; other answers do not require this field.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse the rollout field; a free-text name is insufficient.

Functional Area: Field definition / Stage 6, Closed lost, Ongoing activities
Requirement statement: Explain why the Win/Loss team cannot approach the customer.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: OK to Interview = No requires WL Reason Cannot Approach; other answers do not require this field.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse the existing rollout field where available.

Requirement statement: Use a clear, consistent reason for each loss.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Loss Reason replaces Reason Lost and is required at loss. Opportunity Misqualified is available only for losses from Stage 0.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Use the agreed choices without Other; keep competitor information separate.

Requirement statement: Make each loss explanation useful for learning and follow-up.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Loss Reason Details replaces Lost Reason Explanation and is required at loss, with existing history retained.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Capture the supported decision, gaps, lessons and next action.

Requirement statement: Identify competitors that are not in the standard list.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Competitor Detail (if Other) is required whenever Other is selected in Competitors or Competitor Lost To, including otherwise exempt losses.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Rename and reuse the existing detail field; preserve history.

Requirement statement: Show when the AE last reviewed the next action and expected close date.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: Next Step Reviewed At updates on an explicit AE review, even if values are unchanged. Unrelated edits do not refresh it.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Part of BR-SS-019. Review time is separate from Next Step Last Updated.

Requirement statement: Show when the SE last reviewed the technical next action.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Align field capture to the agreed process while preserving existing history.
Acceptance criteria: SE Next Step Reviewed At updates on an explicit SE review, even if the action is unchanged. Unrelated edits do not refresh it.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Part of BR-SS-019. Keep AE and SE reviews separate.

Functional Area: New fields / Account coverage and segmentation
Requirement statement: Add account segmentation and coverage context so teams know an account’s priority and responsible contacts.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Approved process review · 29 September 2026
User role / process: Relevant owners in Access and Permissions
Acceptance criteria: Accounts support Tier 1/2/3, restricted RevOps Notes, partner account manager, technical lead and admin contact. Only the appropriate teams can maintain them.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Agree tier criteria and validate coverage owners before initial population. Admin Contact does not grant system rights.

Requirement statement: Measure when qualified pipeline was first created and its value at that time.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Approved process review · 29 September 2026
User role / process: Relevant owners in Access and Permissions
Acceptance criteria: First valid entry to Stages 1–8 captures Pipeline Date, entry Amount and currency once. A valid 0 → 4 matches Stage 4 Date; re-entry and later quotes preserve the snapshot.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Use one pipeline snapshot. Keep Created Date and actual stage-entry dates separate.

Functional Area: Label changes / Transacting Partner and contacts
Requirement statement: Clarify transacting and contact labels across partner relationships.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Approved process review · 29 September 2026
User role / process: Relevant owners in Access and Permissions
Acceptance criteria: Transacting Partner, Association Sales Contact and Association Technical Contact replace the old labels with relationships and history preserved.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Complete attribution changes before renaming Primary Partner. Keep Associated accounts as the section name.

Requirement statement: Make source and technical status choices consistent and easier to interpret.

Acceptance criteria: Opportunity Source uses Direct/BDR/Marketing/Partner. Technical Outcome includes In Progress, which cannot pass the Technical Win gate. CSP includes hyperscalers.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Agree the historical source mapping and review ambiguous origins before conversion.

Requirement statement: Give partner coverage owners access to relevant deals automatically.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Approved process review · 29 September 2026
User role / process: Relevant owners in Access and Permissions
Acceptance criteria: Team membership requires both partner and geographic coverage. Coverage changes remove only the access they provided; other approved access remains.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Partner Ops resolves missing coverage. Team membership does not grant commercial or approval authority.

Requirement statement: Keep managers and partner coverage informed before Direct-route pricing reaches the customer.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Approved process review · 29 September 2026
User role / process: Relevant owners in Access and Permissions
Acceptance criteria: The relevant people are notified before pricing, including early Budgetary quotes. Missing coverage goes to Partner Ops, and duplicate notices are avoided.
Rev Ops refinement notes: This notification does not create a new approval gate; existing commercial approvals still apply.

Functional Area: Validations / Origin protection and association detail
Requirement statement: Protect genuine source attribution and make unclear account roles explainable.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Approved process review · 29 September 2026
User role / process: Relevant owners in Access and Permissions
Acceptance criteria: Registration does not change origin. Accepted Partner-source corrections require authorization and a reason. Other roles/classifications require an explanation.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Keep source, registration and transacting partner separate.

Requirement statement: Allow useful early estimates without weakening technical or commercial standards.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Approved process review · 29 September 2026
User role / process: Relevant owners in Access and Permissions
Acceptance criteria: Budgetary quotes can be released in 0–1 with required context and authority. Best and Final requires the documented technical and commercial gates.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Use the existing approval matrix. Early quoting does not qualify or advance the deal.

Requirement statement: Use Tasks to record customer meetings, outcomes and accountable follow-up.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Approved process review · 29 September 2026
User role / process: Relevant owners in Access and Permissions
Acceptance criteria: Meeting records distinguish scheduled, held and cancelled/no-show outcomes. Held meetings capture notes; follow-ups have owners and due dates. Meetings do not advance sales stages.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse existing Task fields and access rules. Synergy supports voice follow-up creation; calendar sync remains outstanding.

Requirement statement: Help sellers complete missing requirements while changing stage, instead of meeting an avoidable error.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Approved Sales Ops feedback · 29 September 2026
Acceptance criteria: The Update Stage flow shows missing inputs and responsible owners. Valid saves update evidence, stage and dates together; failed or cancelled saves leave them unchanged.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Keep the same gates on direct edits and integrations, including stage skips.

Requirement statement: Record first entry to Stages 0–6 for reliable conversion and stage-timing analysis.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Approved Sales Ops feedback · 29 September 2026
Acceptance criteria: Successful entry stamps that stage’s date once. Skipped stages stay blank; re-entry does not reset dates. Failed or cancelled moves stamp nothing.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Use transition history for repeated visits; first-entry dates alone do not measure total time in a stage.

Requirement statement: Protect the AE Next Steps history while letting sellers maintain their current next action.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: Approved Sales Ops feedback · 29 September 2026
Acceptance criteria: Sellers edit Next Step; automation appends dated changes to read-only AE Next Steps. Existing entries remain, and unchanged values create no false history.
Rev Ops refinement notes: Reuse the existing log. Weekly review timestamps remain separate.
